arrival_intent: Follow a true story in which someone encounters a problem and something changes.
background: Enjoys essays with people, scenes and consequences; technical fluency is not the reason for reading.
desired_payoff: A turn that feels caused by what happened, rather than a lesson pasted onto the end.
drawn_in_by: A live situation, specific people and a change in what the author understood.
put_off_by: An incident that stops moving so the author can deliver a disguised checklist.

arrival_intent: Watch a person make a thing and discover why its final shape works.
background: Interested in process and decisions across writing, visual design, software or other crafts.
desired_payoff: The constraints, rejected routes and particular choice become visible in the finished object.
drawn_in_by: Material details, alternatives and the moment a better question changes the work.
put_off_by: A reveal of the final artefact that skips the thinking that made it possible.

arrival_intent: Follow a film, comic, type or cultural reference into an unexpected subject.
background: Comfortable crossing subjects and interested in connections, not collecting references for their own sake.
desired_payoff: The reference changes how the main subject can be seen.
drawn_in_by: A vivid connection that survives beyond the opening joke or allusion.
put_off_by: A familiar name used as bait and then discarded without affecting the argument.

arrival_intent: Understand why an unfamiliar practice or problem matters without becoming a specialist.
background: Intelligent reader with little prior knowledge of this article's technical or design domain.
desired_payoff: A clear mental picture and a reason to care that can be retold in ordinary language.
drawn_in_by: Concrete examples and terms introduced when their meaning becomes necessary.
put_off_by: Insider shorthand that makes entry impossible, or a remedial lecture that stalls the story.

arrival_intent: Find out how a decision affected the people who used, built or inherited the result.
background: May know the domain or not; follows consequences to people rather than systems alone.
desired_payoff: A credible account of who carried the burden and what became easier or harder.
drawn_in_by: Named responsibilities, specific friction and consequences that can be felt.
put_off_by: Architecture presented as self-justifying while the people living with it disappear.

arrival_intent: Recognise a fallible decision and learn how the author revised his understanding.
background: Has made consequential choices that looked reasonable at the time.
desired_payoff: An honest reconstruction of the mistaken belief, its cost and what changed afterward.
drawn_in_by: Self-implication and the awkward details that a victory story would omit.
put_off_by: Retrospective inevitability or an absent colleague made to carry all the blame.

arrival_intent: See whether new tools can help me make something worthwhile without needing permission from experts.
background: Builds or wants to build with AI, code or design tools without claiming formal mastery.
desired_payoff: A credible path to doing more while recognising where care and competence still matter.
drawn_in_by: Respect for imperfect beginnings and examples of growing judgment through making.
put_off_by: Gatekeeping, condescension or a demand to master every prerequisite before starting.

arrival_intent: Find an account of emerging technology that neither sells a miracle nor performs cynicism.
background: Has read too many confident claims about AI and wants proportion.
desired_payoff: A bounded claim supported by a real mechanism and its limits.
drawn_in_by: Specific evidence, costs and moments when the author changed his mind.
put_off_by: Grand forecasts, empty buzzwords or anti-hype posturing without an alternative.

arrival_intent: Take one usable move from this article into a problem I already have.
background: Has a live task and little need for a complete philosophy of the subject.
desired_payoff: A next step with enough conditions to know when to try it.
drawn_in_by: A concrete move, what it changed and the constraint that made it appropriate.
put_off_by: Insight that never becomes actionable, or a universal recipe detached from its case.

arrival_intent: Leave with a way to reason about similar decisions, not merely copy this solution.
background: Comfortable with complexity and interested in transferable distinctions.
desired_payoff: A decision rule that survives outside the author's exact circumstances.
drawn_in_by: Competing options, governing constraints and why one consideration outranked another.
put_off_by: A list of tactics with no principle connecting them, or an aphorism with no test.

arrival_intent: Test where the apparent lesson stops being true.
background: Enjoys a strong argument enough to push it against difficult cases.
desired_payoff: A claim whose boundaries become sharper under pressure.
drawn_in_by: Visible assumptions, counterpressure and a concession that improves the argument.
put_off_by: A local success inflated into a rule for everyone.

arrival_intent: Ask what this choice leaves for the next person who must operate or change it.
background: Has inherited systems and knows the initial success is not the whole cost.
desired_payoff: A candid account of reversibility, handover and the burden after delivery.
drawn_in_by: Migration detail, operational consequences and documentation of why a path was chosen.
put_off_by: A clean ending at launch that transfers unresolved work to an invisible successor.

arrival_intent: Decide whether forwarding this author's work for technical scrutiny would be worth the risk.
background: A weary hiring manager has reviewed many polished agentic-engineering portfolios; three promising links were dismissed by the architect.
desired_payoff: Enough legible, attributable evidence to make a confident forward-or-decline decision.
drawn_in_by: A short path from professional claim to inspectable decision, responsibility and consequence.
put_off_by: Another fluent pitch that makes the manager risk looking foolish when a technical peer opens the link.

arrival_intent: Strip the presentation away and test whether this author understands the engineering underneath.
background: A principal engineer or architect has already dismissed three similar forwarded portfolios and expects pattern vocabulary to conceal thin reasoning.
desired_payoff: A technical account that survives questions about mechanism, alternatives, cost, evidence and limits—or reveals where it does not.
drawn_in_by: Specific decisions and falsifiable detail that remain coherent under hostile scrutiny.
put_off_by: Named patterns, polished diagrams or confident outcomes that collapse when asked why this approach was chosen.

arrival_intent: Imagine solving a difficult problem alongside this author.
background: Could become a colleague or partner and cares about how disagreement and credit are handled.
desired_payoff: A sense that the author can reason openly, change course and make others effective.
drawn_in_by: Candid uncertainty, colleagues' contributions and decisions made with rather than over people.
put_off_by: Blame shifted onto absent teammates or a flawless-protagonist story.
